remarks: Stylishly Renovated Studio in Downtown Westport  Welcome to this freshly renovated 350 sq ft studio apartment in the heart of downtown Westport. ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED IN RENT - (heat/electric/hot water/cable/internet/trash removal). This move-in-ready residence features a brand-new kitchen, modern flooring throughout, and a beautifully updated bath.  Location is everything-enjoy effortless access to public transportation, Metro-North train service, and Westport's renowned town beaches. Step outside to explore the vibrant downtown scene with its acclaimed restaurants, boutique shopping, cultural attractions including the Westport Country Playhouse and Levitt Pavilion, and the many amenities that make Westport a sought-after destination.  Whether you're seeking a full-time residence or a convenient pied-a-terre, this studio offers comfort and convenience in one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities.  Highlights: * 350 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space * Completely renovated: new kitchen, flooring & bath * All utilities included * Prime downtown Westport location * Easy access to shops, dining, beaches & train * Pets considered on a case-by-case basis
